dataset: synthetic public renders; private source not published

central.method: rejected redesign; three structural alternatives; retained implementation review rounds

topology: Same native parent; independent backend, designer, visual critic and two raw-prose-only blind reading children. All children explicitly gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh; spawn settings accepted. Parent integrates, checks and delivers.

continuity.scope: Structural completeness is checked separately from literary judgment; AI inference is not measured reader emotion.

limits: Public captures use a synthetic four-paragraph counterpart, not the private original.
Agent visual review does not establish owner comfort or physical-device acceptance.
1366x768 is CSS viewport size at DPR1/zoom1; a separate 1366x590 usable-height diagnostic is retained.
Browsers without Custom Highlight retain labels and details with an explicit colors-unavailable notice.
Legacy sparse annotations remain append-only evidence and require regeneration; no gap emotions are inferred.
Existing quote/beat/size bounds remain; over-limit full readings cannot claim coverage.
No polling or Firestore listener additions; only local DOM viewport/scroll observation.
